# Licences of the vendored motion libraries

The files and versions are in `VERSIONS.md` beside this file.

## GSAP 3.15.0: the Standard "no charge" licence

Applies to `gsap.min.js`, `ScrollTrigger.min.js`, `SplitText.min.js`, `Flip.min.js` and `ScrambleTextPlugin.min.js`. The package's `package.json` names it as `Standard 'no charge' license: https://gsap.com/standard-license.`; the text below is that page's, fetched on 4 November 2026, unchanged apart from the page's FAQ, which is not part of the terms and is left out. The page says the licence is incorporated into Webflow's Terms of Service, which the page links.
